Three positions progress from three-quarter side toward frontal spread-wing endpoint; repaired middle turn fully framed.
Exact reversed turn sequence from frontal to three-quarter; all three source positions checked.
Exact alias of group 7, retained as its own original slot, both facings checked.
Exact alias of group 8, retained as its own original slot, both facings checked.
